items.name: TJHSST Fall 2016

venue.name: [Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology](https://tjhsst.edu/)
venue.details: The competition is being held in the Cafeteria, which is on the first floor, there will be signs directing you there.

items.information: There is a 100 competitor limit for TJHSST Fall 2016, on a first-come, first-serve basis. Registration is $15, must be paid online via Paypal, and is nonrefundable after November 1st. Spectators come in for free. Unfortunately, we are no longer able to allow people to pay in cash at the door. Registration is not final until payment is complete and your name appears on the competitor list.
